facts.fact: Folkehaven 任其崩塌：碎块滑进黑水、屋顶塌、hollow 先淹——浅坟被泥雨填平「As if it was never there.」
facts.anchor: As if it was never there.

facts.fact: 白猫回归（更瘦、肋骨再现）——手套真相终审：「I do not know if the white cat escaped my mother’s hands, or if my mother made it to taunt me all along. It matters little now.」
facts.anchor: I think of the gloves, the softness of them

facts.fact: 猫叼黑鼠、颈血染白毛「beautiful scarlet」；不哈气了「waits, watches」；鬼群围观不尖叫——「a strange sort of acceptance, an almost peace. I feel it too」
facts.anchor: painting her pristine fur in a beautiful scarlet

facts.fact: 猫跳进怀里、影子缠结伸长——「A scythe glints in the pure moonlight. We walk together, joined as I suppose we always have been, always should have been」——身后「not a soul left at Folkehaven」
facts.anchor: A scythe glints in the pure moonlight.

facts.fact: 终句：死亡如暖衣如拥抱——「I am longed for, welcomed, feared and loved, despised. As it should be.」
facts.anchor: I am longed for, welcomed, feared and loved, despised.
